Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.event

Klasse NpcDamageEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.event.NpcEvent
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.event.NpcDamageEvent
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
public class NpcDamageEvent extends NpcEvent implements org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
Fired when a player attacks an NPC that is not invulnerable.

Follows NpcInteractEvent, and only for NPCs whose NpcAppearance.invulnerable() is false. It exists for the plugins that care about combat specifically and would otherwise have to filter every interaction; a listener that just wants to know about clicks should use NpcInteractEvent.

BetterNPCs does not itself model NPC health. getDamage() is the damage the player's attack would have dealt, offered so that a combat or quest plugin can apply its own rules; nothing happens to the NPC if no plugin acts on it.

Cancelling suppresses the hurt animation the engine would otherwise play.

Seit:
1.0.0
